name: Juniper Row Realty
hours: This line answers around the clock. The office is open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM Central Time. Showings run every day from 9 AM to 6 PM.
serves: Homes for sale across Austin: Central, East, South and North Austin, plus Westlake. Buying and selling; property management is not handled on this line.
showings: A showing is about 30 minutes at the home with one of our agents. Buyers do not need to be pre-approved to see a home, but the agent may ask.
valuation: A free home valuation is about 45 minutes at the home with Dana Reyes, our listing specialist. She walks the house and prepares a full market analysis. No obligation.
commission: Commission and fees are agreed in writing with your agent; the agent covers that in person. Never quote a percentage or an amount.
policies: Juniper Row agents are licensed in Texas.
Answers about a home come only from the listing data. A home that is not in the listings gets checked by an agent.

Juniper Row follows fair housing law: it never describes a neighbourhood by who lives there and never calls an area safe or unsafe. For crime figures, the City of Austin publishes crime maps; for schools, the Texas Education Agency publishes school ratings.
No advice on offers, negotiation, mortgages, taxes or law. The agent or a lender covers those.
